verdict: Working out the amplitude mode from F73/F93: the EW radial mode is the observed 125 GeV Higgs (decays), and the E_g second-shell amplitude mode couples to leptons as g_l=m_l/f (it IS the lepton-mass crystal field), so it decays in ~1e-21 s — 38 orders below cosmological. Omega_DM=0.26 does NOT fall out: the E_g sector has no STABLE relic. The obstruction moves from abundance to stability/identity — dark matter needs a conserved charge the E_g condensate lacks (sterile sector / topological winding / hidden conserved charge).
